description: Open the T8 housing bracket model (pre-loaded) and create a symmetric assembly. 1) Select the bracket body. 2) Create a mirrored copy across the YZ plane (Mirror normal to X axis) using the Part workbench Mirror tool. 3) Select both the original and the mirrored shape and combine them into a Part Compound (Part > Compound > Make Compound). 4) Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/symmetric_bracket_assembly.FCStd'.
